items.title: Building AI-Powered NPCs in Unreal Engine 5.7
items.excerpt: NVIDIA walks game developers through building on-device, low-latency AI-powered NPCs in Unreal Engine 5.7 using the NVIDIA ACE Game Agent SDK — distilling speech recognition, a small language model and text-to-speech into RTX-deployable characters. A concrete workflow shift for how studios author conversational NPCs.
